api_base.description: The API base for the Guardrails AI guardrail. Defaults to http://0.0.0.0:8000, the `GUARDRAILS_AI_API_BASE` environment variable is checked.

guard_name.description: The name of the Guardrails AI guardrail. Required for the Guardrails AI guardrail.

guardrails_ai_api_input_format.description: The format of the input to the Guardrails AI API. Defaults to 'llmOutput'.
